visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a well-groomed male character with dark hair. He has white and black patterned eye patches under his eyes and is gently touching his face. The setting is a brightly lit, neutral indoor room, likely a home or studio. A yellow subtitle appears at the bottom. (2) The character holds up a gold-capped skincare jar and then a tall, elegant pink bottle toward the camera. He wears a white silk robe, suggesting a luxury skincare routine. (3) He displays a white paper bag with black handles and a prominent luxury brand logo on the front. He looks excited and smiles at the camera. (4) A large, pink, open presentation box is shown, filled with various skincare products including bottles, jars, and compacts, all in gold and pink packaging. (5) In a series of medium shots and close-ups, the character demonstrates the use of several products. He pours clear liquid from a gold-capped bottle into his palm, applies serum with a dropper, and removes eye patches from a container. (6) He applies cream from a jar to his cheeks and forehead, smoothing it into his skin. His complexion appears radiant and clear. (7) He applies a lip scrub and then a lip oil, puckering his lips towards the camera. (8) In the final phase, he removes the eye patches, showing brightened skin. He applies a tinted cream and a gold-cased lipstick. He ends by posing with two products and winking, while a large brand logo appears on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with high-energy electronic pop music featuring a strong synthesized beat. A male narrator begins speaking in an enthusiastic, high-arousal tone in Mandarin. (2) A metallic clicking sound is heard as a product cap is opened. The narrator continues describing the '颜值最高的保养系列'. (3) Soft rustling sounds of a paper bag and product box are audible as the character unboxes the items. The music remains consistent and upbeat. (4) Distinct liquid pour and soft splashing sounds occur as the character demonstrates the hydration booster. The narration remains fast-paced and clear. (5) A sharp 'peel' sound effect is used when the eye patches are shown and then removed later. The music swells slightly during transitions between product reveals. (6) Subtle rubbing or patting sounds accompany the visual of skin application. The narrator's pitch rises during emphasis words like '提亮' (brighten). (7) The music reaches a final peak with a rhythmic flourish as the brand name is stated. The audio ends with the music fading quickly after the final slogan.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step Demonstration -> Result -> CTA/Brand Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for the Dolce & Gabbana skincare collection. It uses a high-energy, vlog-style demonstration to showcase the luxury packaging and the immediate visual effects of the products on the character's skin to entice consumers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The character explicitly identifies the products, shows the brand logo multiple times, and provides a step-by-step usage guide for the entire product line.
